name: Realvolve
description: Realvolve is a real-estate CRM for managing client relationships, contacts, properties, transactions, tasks, calendars, communications and automated workflows.
agentUseSummary: Realvolve is visible as a security-review preview. Relay will not collect its broad Utility or Zapier API key until Realvolve publishes a least-privilege third-party authorization and lifecycle contract.

capabilities.label: Review bounded Realvolve integration access
capabilities.description: If Realvolve publishes a least-privilege contract, expose only exact-account, privacy-redacted tools after security review.

blocked.label: Capture a Realvolve API key
blocked.description: Relay will not request a broad Utility or Zapier API key for this preview.

blocked.label: Read private Realvolve CRM data
blocked.description: Contacts, properties, transactions, messages, notes, files, calendars, tasks, relationships and team data are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change contacts or start workflows
blocked.description: Creating or updating contacts, assigning owners, attaching notes or files, and starting workflows are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run Realvolve actions before security review
blocked.description: No Realvolve tool is callable until Realvolve documents exact endpoints and schemas, granular scopes, account binding, key lifecycle, limits, auditing and third-party distribution terms.

approvalProfiles.label: Realvolve API-key security review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable because the documented key can write sensitive contact data without a public least-privilege lifecycle.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable under Realvolve's documented broad API-key contract.
No Hermes tools are callable under Realvolve's documented broad API-key contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Realvolve exposes a Utility or Zapier API key for third-party integrations that can create or update contacts and start workflows across sensitive identity, address, phone, email, notes, ownership and attachment fields. Public material does not define stable endpoints and schemas, granular scopes, immutable account claims, expiration, rotation, revocation, limits or general distribution terms.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask Realvolve for a production third-party API contract covering exact endpoints and schemas, least-privilege read scopes, immutable account and user binding, key issuance, expiration, rotation and revocation, limits, audit identifiers and distribution. Re-run privacy and security review before implementing typed bounded tools.

evidence.supports: Realvolve documents a Zapier API key from account integration settings and a create-or-update contact action, but not a granular authorization or token lifecycle.
The integration can write names, companies, home and work addresses, phones, emails, tags, source, owner, notes, attachments and workflow-start controls.
Realvolve describes a CRM spanning clients, transactions, messages, tasks, notes, files, emails, texts and automated workflows.
Realvolve's privacy material covers contacts, properties, documents, email and text data, reinforcing the need for least privilege and data minimization.
Realvolve's terms govern user credentials, private contact lists, communications and service access; Relay must not infer unpublished API distribution rights.
